stateDir.description: Where reports and memory are kept (default .seo-autopilot).

llm.description: Optional AI step for wording, judging and ideas. Without it every job runs rule-based.

provider.description: claude-code: the Claude Code CLI on your Claude subscription (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, no API key). anthropic or openai: pay-per-use API keys. none: AI off. Default: whichever login is set.

model.description: Model name or alias (claude-code default: sonnet). SEO_MODEL overrides it.

dataDir.description: Editable data files, playbooks and agents (default seo-autopilot).

stateBranch.description: Git branch that holds the saved state (default seo-data). It is force-pushed: never name a branch the site is built or released from (main, master, ... are refused).

url.description: Must start with https:// and end with a slash.

thinIgnore.description: URL path patterns (use * as a wildcard) for pages that are meant to be short, such as hubs, tools and funnel pages. The thin-content rule skips them.

retired.description: URL path patterns for pages that were removed or redirected on purpose. They are left out of the not-indexed counts and request lists.

business.description: The business name, phone and address as you confirm them. The local job checks that the site shows exactly these.

verticals.description: Specialist packs for this kind of business. Without this setting they are detected from the site profile. [] turns them off.

language.description: Language the site publishes in (for example en). Search queries clearly in another language are not turned into topic proposals.

unpublish.description: How seo-watch takes a harmful new page off the site without deleting it: the front-matter or JSON field it sets (default { "field": "draft", "value": true }; Jekyll: { "field": "published", "value": false }). Your build must leave such pages out.

contentGuard.description: Content-loss guard in seo-check (read from the base branch's config, so a pull request cannot loosen its own check).

maxWordDropPercent.description: Most words a changed page may lose, in percent (default 15). Removing any heading, internal link, image or structured data always fails.

watch.description: seo-watch for refreshes and new pages merged from seo/* branches.

content.description: Watch refreshes and new pages (default true). The undo-level watch of the autopilot is separate.

days.description: Days each change is watched after the lag (default 28).

lag.description: Days skipped after the merge while search engines pick the change up (default 3).

minSpan.description: Days of data needed after the lag before clicks are compared (default 14).

pagesPerDay.description: Content-pace governor: most pages to release in one day (default 2).

perTemplatePerDay.description: Most pages of one template (page type) in one day.

topics.description: Topic name to a list of keyword regex sources. Adds to or replaces the built-in topics; an empty list switches one off.

requireFields.description: Content fields a sensitive page must have (default author, reviewedBy).

market.description: Where and in which language the site is researched. Required by every job that calls a search or keyword provider; there is no default. See docs/configuration.md#market.

location_code.description: DataForSEO location code (also the Google Ads geo target id), for example 2682 for Saudi Arabia.

location.description: Instead of location_code: a country name from the supported list or its two-letter code, for example "Saudi Arabia" or "SA".

country.description: Two-letter country code; needed only when location_code is not in the built-in table.

languages.description: Languages the site publishes in; the first is the primary one.

translations.description: The same page in each of the site's languages, one group per page, for example [{ "ar": "/ar/store/", "en": "/en/store/" }]. Every language code must be one of market.languages. The hreflang check in seo-check reads these groups. See docs/arabic.md.

additionalProperties.description: A path that starts with / or a full URL of this site.

searchConsole.description: How the site's Search Console queries are filtered so another country's or language's rows do not dilute the numbers. See docs/arabic.md.

country.description: true (default): only the market's country. false: no country filter. A two-letter country code overrides the market's.

additionalProperties.description: Where the language lives, for example "/ar/". One language may be "/" (everything outside the others).

languagePaths.description: Where each language lives on the site. The primary language is the default for queries; --language picks another, --language all none.

hreflang.description: The hreflang check on the declared translation groups, run by seo-check (docs/arabic.md). Read from the base branch's config, so a pull request cannot loosen its own check.

buildDir.description: Folder the build writes the pages to (for example dist). Pages are read from there; without it pass --dir or --live.

xDefault.description: true: every page must carry hreflang="x-default" pointing at the primary language's page. A language code: point at that language's page. false (default): not required.

block.description: true: a missing or one-way link fails seo-check. Default false: it warns.

styleGuide.description: Writing rules injected into every drafting and review of a language (docs/arabic.md). The built-in Modern Standard Arabic guide applies to sites that publish in Arabic.

additionalProperties.description: Path of the site's own rules for that language, relative to the config file.

files.description: A style-guide file per language, added on top of the built-in guide.

builtin.description: false: do not use the built-in guide, only the site's own files.

dataforseo.description: Cost guard for every paid DataForSEO call (see docs/configuration.md#dataforseo-cost-guard). Calls are refused, with no request sent, when this month's recorded spend plus an estimate would pass monthlyCapUsd, or when the live account balance would fall under minBalanceUsd.

monthlyCapUsd.description: Most this site's jobs may spend on DataForSEO in one calendar month (UTC), in US dollars.

minBalanceUsd.description: Paid calls stop when the account balance (read from the free appendix/user_data endpoint) would fall under this, in US dollars.

aeo.description: AI answer tracking (the `aeo` job, docs/aeo.md): buyer questions asked to Google's AI answers through DataForSEO, looking for your names and domain. Needs the site's market and DataForSEO credentials; every call goes through the cost guard.

prompts.description: The questions to ask. `lang` must be one of market.languages (default: the market's main language).

aliases.description: Names to look for in answers, in any script (Arabic is compared without diacritics). The site's domain is always looked for.

mode.description: Which AI answer to read: Google AI Overview, Google AI Mode, or ChatGPT with web search (LLM Responses API).

schedule.description: How often the job asks again; a run before it is due does nothing unless --force.

maxCostPerRunUsd.description: Hard stop for one run, in US dollars, on top of the DataForSEO monthly cap.

market.description: No longer read. Use the site's market.

conversions.description: Conversions check: the GA4 events this site should send (default ["generate_lead"]).

autopilot.description: What publishes by itself (D17). Levels: watch < prepare < autopilot < undo. Sensitive topics, site-wide indexing, migrations, deletions and outreach never go above prepare.

paused.description: Kill switch: nothing merges or publishes automatically. The repository variable SEO_AUTOPILOT_PAUSED=true does the same.

logs.description: Crawler log analysis. Folder of server access logs (plain or .gz). Default: <dataDir>/logs. Keep logs out of git: they contain visitors' IP addresses.

portal.description: Client portal snapshot (the portal job). All optional.

market.description: Shown to the client, for example "United Kingdom, Greater Manchester".

schedule.description: When the reports run, as shown to the client.

locationPattern.description: Regular expression for location pages: group 1 is the area, group 2 (optional) the town. Default matches /areas/, /locations/ and /service-areas/.

keywords.description: How many keywords the snapshot keeps (default 80).

research.description: Research suite: keyword explorer, rank tracker, gap, optimiser, AI visibility and authority. All optional.

market.description: No longer read. Use the site's market (location and language).

competitors.description: Competitor domains, for example ["rival.com"]. Otherwise found from share of voice.

competitorNames.description: Competitor names to look for in AI answers.

aliases.description: Other names of the business to detect in AI answers (short forms, misspellings).

engines.description: AI engines to ask (default: every engine with a key; dataforseo only when named here, because it spends through the cost guard).

aiRuns.description: Times each question is asked per engine (default 2).

logo.description: Full URL of the logo image, used in suggested Organization markup.

sameAs.description: Your official profile URLs (social, Wikipedia, Wikidata, directories), used in suggested Organization markup and the entity check.

serpLimit.description: Tracked queries checked live by rank --serp (default 50).

youtubeChannel.description: Your YouTube channel name, to find where it ranks in video results for your topics.

stackExchangeSites.description: Stack Exchange sites to mine questions from in keywords, for example ["webmasters", "money"] (free, no key).

inbound.description: Inbound links audit. Folder of Search Console or backlink-tool CSV exports. Default: <dataDir>/inbound-links.

strict.description: Exit 1 when a claim is unverified, so a build or pull-request check blocks it.

redirects.description: Redirect map for the redirects job. Default file: <dataDir>/redirects.json (redirects-<id>.json when the config has several sites).

output.description: File the generated rules go into with --write, between seo-autopilot markers (for example public/.htaccess).
